about.title: Stockton Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a death in Stockton happens because someone else was careless, the questions arrive faster than the answers. Who covers the funeral? What happens to the income that kept the household running? California gives certain family members a way to ask those questions in civil court. A wrongful death claim belongs first to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and the children; if there are none, it can pass to other dependents or heirs. San Joaquin County public collision records show 21 traffic deaths in Stockton during 2025, alongside 1,313 injury collisions. Corridors like El Dorado Street, Hammer Lane, Airport Way and March Lane carry the highest volume of reported crashes, and Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. see the most reports. Not every loss involves a vehicle, of course. Workplace incidents, unsafe premises and medical errors can also support a claim. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent attorney who takes these cases on contingency, so you can focus on your family while someone else manages the paperwork.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most California wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a government entity is involved. Early guidance keeps options open.

items.title: Every category of loss counted
items.desc: Funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance are all recoverable under California law. Contingency fees mean nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. The criminal case is brought by the San Joaquin County District Attorney and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action brought by the family to recover losses. One can proceed regardless of what happens in the other, and a different standard of proof applies in civil court.

items.question: My father died in a crash on Hammer Lane. Who in our family is allowed to bring the claim?
items.answer: Under California law, his surviving spouse or domestic partner and his children have the first right to file. If none exist, certain dependents or heirs may qualify instead. An attorney can review your family's situation and confirm who has standing before the two-year deadline approaches.

items.question: What does LawProactive charge for connecting us with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing. Our service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorney you are matched with works on contingency, which means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery in your case.
